# Test excerpt: Open Goldberg Variations

`variatio4-5s.flac`: the first 5 seconds of Variatio 4 (BWV 988), with a 50 ms fade out;
24-bit, 96 kHz, stereo, no tags.

- Performance: Kimiko Ishizaka, piano, *The Open Goldberg Variations* (2012).
- Source: <https://archive.org/details/OpenGoldbergVariations> (24-bit FLAC, 96 kHz).
- License: [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), dedicated to the
  public domain by the performer and the project (<https://opengoldbergvariations.org/>).
  No attribution is required; we credit the project anyway.

`fw/tools/mktestset.py` makes the test set from it: each format and rate the player reads,
tag variations and cover art of several sizes (see the script's help).
